channel.name: Pixel History
channel.description: History documentary storytelling: how societies, empires and ideas actually unfolded.
channel.tagline: History, told like it actually happened.

audience.what_they_know: Knows the headline facts and dates from school, but not how events connected.
audience.what_they_want: Cause and consequence, human stakes, and a sense of why the past still matters.

writing.style: Documentary narration with strong narrative arcs
writing.person: third person with occasional direct address
avoid: Invented quotes or invented personal details
Treating contested claims as settled fact
Modern-day analogies that flatten the historical context
prefer: Specific dates, places and material detail
The human cost behind the political decision

video.hook_style: Open inside a decisive moment, then zoom out to the cause
video.ending_style: Close on the legacy and what the modern world inherited

visuals.visual_preference: Historically grounded realism with painterly depth
visuals.lighting: Natural directional light, candle and window sources, atmospheric haze
visuals.texture: Film grain, aged patina, shallow depth of field
avoid_visuals: Modern objects or technology in historical scenes
Modern national borders presented as ancient ones
Medieval armour, castle or costume motifs in a Roman setting

audio.mixing_style: Narration forward, score supporting emotional beats
audio.energy: Slow build, restrained tension, reflective resolution
audio.notes: Avoid modern percussion in historical segments.

primary: Ideas and inventions that outlived their era
avoid: Present-day political analogies presented as direct parallels
